title: Agent Run Ledger v0
description: A structured ledger format an agent produces during a single trial of a benchmark task. The ledger is the runtime evidence that a claim card cites. Field names use task-ontology primitives where applicable.

run_identity.description: Identifiers tying this ledger to a specific run, task, and trial.

run_id.description: Stable identifier of the parent run.

task_id.description: Identifier of the task within the benchmark.

trial_id.description: Identifier of this trial within the task (e.g. UUID, or numeric index for k>1).

dataset.description: Dataset string as recorded in result.json (e.g. terminal-bench/terminal-bench-2-1).

timestamp.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when this trial started.

task.description: Task description, structured using task-ontology primitives. See https://github.com/0error-ob/task-ontology/blob/main/PRIMITIVES.md

actor.description: task-ontology primitive: the system-under-evaluation as a delimited entity.

goal.description: task-ontology primitive: the terminal condition that defines done.

transform_type.description: task-ontology primitive: the class of operation required. May compose multiple types.

initial_state.description: task-ontology primitive: what the actor inherits at t=0.

target_state.description: task-ontology primitive: the state that, when reached, satisfies the goal predicate.

constraints.description: task-ontology primitive: rules and budgets that exclude regions of action space.

tools.description: task-ontology primitive: action affordances available to the actor.

environment.description: task-ontology primitive: mutability and other agents outside the actor's deliberation.

feedback.description: task-ontology primitive: signals returned during execution (distinct from terminal scoring).

phases.description: Execution record, organized by phase. Phase names should align with the routing schema if one is in use.

name.description: Phase name (e.g. probe, execute, verify, stop).

actions.description: Actions taken in this phase, in order.

observations.description: Observations recorded by the actor in this phase.

ledger_writes.description: Phase-specific structured writes. Field names should match the routing schema's ledger_writes for this phase.

verifier_evidence.description: Output of the verifier run. Required if the phase named 'verify' completed.

failure_class.description: If the trial did not pass, classification of failure cause.

cost.description: task-ontology primitive: units of effort consumed in producing this trial.
